time_limitation: File timestamp documents capture, not the precise instant-query evaluation time. Dashboard displays Last 7 days UTC.
limitations: Ratios and budgets are estimates calculated from rounded dashboard values; raw instant-query export is not retained.
Increase extrapolates cumulative counters; displayed values are not literal raw request counts.
The configured seven-day lookback is not proof of seven days of observed history.
The dataset includes verification traffic, including deliberate authentication rejection checks.
Freshness is verified for this captured observation only, not continuous exporter uptime or complete history.
This is not evidence of alert receipt/resolution, rollback, or a game day.
